home.description: Set Kadai up the way your shop works.
home.empty_description: Ask the owner or a manager to change settings.

upgrade.feature_title: “{{feature}}” is not in your current plan
upgrade.limit_title_generic: {{what}}: you have reached your plan's limit
upgrade.description: Move to a higher plan to add more. Your data stays exactly as it is.
upgrade.description_onprem: Buy an add-on or a higher edition from the licence screen.

common.store_scoped_readonly: You have access to some stores only. Business-wide settings can be changed only by someone with access to every store.
common.stale_write: Someone else changed this in the meantime. Reload to see the latest details, then make your change again.

gstin.bad_state: “{{code}}” is not a valid state code
gstin.bad_format: The GSTIN format is not right (e.g. 33AAAPL1234C1ZL)
gstin.bad_checksum: The check character doesn't match — one of the characters is mistyped. Compare with your GST certificate.

address.district_hint: Start typing for Tamil Nadu districts

logo.label: Shop logo
logo.hint: PNG, JPG or WebP · up to {{size}} MB · printed on A4 invoices

business.description: Your shop's official details, printed on every bill.
business.section_names_hint: The name printed at the top of your bills.
business.name: Shop name (English)
business.legal_name_hint: Only if the name on your GST registration differs from the shop name.
business.business_type_hint: Contact Kadai support to change it.
business.section_gst_hint: Your GST scheme decides how bills are made.
business.scheme_regular_hint: Tax invoices show CGST / SGST separately and business buyers can claim input tax credit. Most shops are in this scheme.
business.scheme_composition_hint: For shops with yearly sales up to ₹1.5 crore. You pay a flat 1% on sales and must not collect GST from customers — bills print as a “Bill of Supply”.
business.scheme_unregistered_hint: Small shops with yearly sales below ₹40 lakh. Bills carry no GST.
business.gstin_hint: Your 15-character GST number from the GST certificate
business.pan_hint: Filled in from a valid GSTIN
business.state_hint: The first two digits of the GSTIN must be this state code
business.section_contact_hint: Shown on bills and in messages to customers.
business.section_language_hint: Language of new bills, customer messages and new users' screens.
business.fy_note: Financial year {{fy}} (starts in {{month}}). Contact support to change the starting month.
business.scheme_confirm_description: Bills were already made in this financial year. The change applies to new bills only — check with your auditor before filing GST returns. This change is recorded in the audit log.

validation.pan_gstin_mismatch: This PAN does not match the PAN inside the GSTIN
validation.fssai: The FSSAI licence number has 14 digits

validation.series_too_long: The number is too long for this document type
validation.pin_weak: This PIN is too easy to guess (like 1234 or 1111). Choose another.
validation.logo_file: Upload an image file as the logo
validation.next_number_decrease: The next number cannot go down — numbers already used must not repeat
validation.register_series_only: Counter-wise series exist only for invoices and bills of supply
validation.file_type: This type of file is not accepted
validation.file_content: The file content does not match its type (is it really an image or PDF?)

errors.self_action: You can't do this to yourself. Ask another admin.
errors.last_owner: The business must keep at least one active owner.
errors.owner_only: Only an owner can do this.
errors.role_exceeds_own_permissions: You can't give permissions that you don't have yourself.
errors.store_scope: This is outside the stores you have access to.
errors.all_stores_required: This needs access to every store.
errors.shared_identity: This person also works with another business; only they can change their name, email or password.

errors.account_disabled: The Kadai account of this mobile number is disabled.
errors.email_taken: This email belongs to another Kadai account.
errors.sms_not_configured: SMS is not set up. Use a temporary password instead.
errors.system_role: This is a built-in role; its permissions can't be changed and it can't be deleted.
errors.role_in_use: Members still have this role. Give them another role first.

errors.role_in_use_other: {{count}} members have this role. Give them another role first.
errors.role_code_reserved: This code is reserved for a built-in role; choose another.
errors.store_code_locked: This store already has bill numbers, so its code can't change.
errors.register_code_locked: This counter already has bill numbers, so its code can't change.
errors.last_active_store: At least one store must stay active.
errors.register_store_mismatch: This counter belongs to another store.
errors.series_exists: This series already exists — refresh the list and edit it.
errors.series_in_use: Documents were already issued in this series.
errors.prefix_in_use: Another series of this year already uses this prefix.
errors.gst_scheme_change_requires_confirm: Bills exist in this financial year, so the scheme change needs confirmation.
errors.upload_permission: You are not allowed to upload this file.

stores.description: Each branch of your shop. The store code is part of every bill number (S1/2627/00001).
stores.add_description: A new branch gets its own bill numbers, stock and counters.
stores.created: {{name}} added. Add a billing counter for it next.
stores.code_locked_hint: Can't change after the first bill
stores.code_taken: Another store already uses this code
stores.name: Store name
stores.gstin_hint: Leave empty to use the business GSTIN
stores.drug_license_hint: Form 20 / 21 numbers — printed on every bill
stores.fssai_hint: 14 digits — printed on bills of food items
stores.active_hint: Billing, stock and transfers are allowed.
stores.inactive_hint: Deactivated: no new bills; old bills and reports stay.
stores.empty_description: Add your first store to start billing.
stores.code_note: Tip: keep store codes short — they appear on every bill number and receipt.

registers.description: Billing counters and the computers trusted to bill at them.
registers.title: Billing counters
registers.list_description: Each counter gets its own bill numbers (S1-A/…), so counters keep billing even without internet.
registers.add_description: Give the counter a short code — it becomes part of its bill numbers.
registers.code_taken: Another counter of this store already uses this code
registers.name: Counter name
registers.printer_name_hint: For your reference, e.g. the model
registers.auto_print_hint: Print the receipt as soon as a bill is saved.
registers.silent_print_hint: The Kadai desktop shortcut prints without the print dialog.
registers.customer_display_hint: Show the bill and UPI QR to the customer on a second screen.
registers.cash_drawer_hint: Open the drawer through the receipt printer after cash bills.
registers.scale_hint: Read weights straight from a scale connected to this counter
registers.scale_on: Scale connected — weights are read automatically
registers.scale_enabled: Use a weighing scale at this counter
registers.scale_enabled_hint: Works in Chrome / Edge on the counter computer (USB or serial cable).
registers.scale_command_hint: Sent to ask for the weight, e.g. W or P
registers.scale_pattern_hint: Only if weights are read wrongly: a regular expression whose first group is the number.
registers.scale_stable_hint: Ignore readings the scale marks as unstable.
registers.active_hint: Deactivated counters can't bill; their old bills stay.
registers.empty_description: Add a billing counter for each place where you make bills.

devices.title: Trusted computers
devices.description: Computers registered as counters. Revoke one that is lost, sold or replaced.
devices.this_registered: This computer is a registered counter
devices.this_not_registered: Register this computer as a counter
devices.this_benefits: Cashiers can then switch users with their PIN in seconds, and bills made without internet get this counter's own numbers.
devices.this_other_business: This computer is registered with another business. Register it again to use it as a counter here.
devices.forget_description: PIN sign-in will stop on this computer. To block it completely, also revoke it in the list below.
devices.register_title: Register this computer as a counter
devices.register_description: Choose where this computer bills. Only this browser keeps the secret key.
devices.register_field_hint: Bills made on this computer get this counter's numbers
devices.no_register_hint: Only for PIN sign-in, not for billing
devices.no_registers: This store has no billing counter yet.
devices.name: Name of this computer
devices.name_hint: Shown in the list, e.g. Counter 1 PC
devices.registered_toast: This computer is now a trusted counter
devices.done_counter: This computer now bills as {{register}} at {{store}}
devices.done_store: This computer is now trusted at {{store}}
devices.done_hint: Cashiers can switch with their PIN here. If this browser's data is cleared, register the computer again.
devices.revoke_description: Everyone signed in on that computer is signed out, and PIN sign-in there stops.
devices.revoke_this_description: This is the computer you are using. PIN sign-in will stop here and its saved key is removed.
devices.empty_description: Register each counter computer once — from that computer — using the button above.

users.description: Your team: who can sign in, what they can do and in which stores.
users.invite_description: They sign in with their mobile number. You choose what they can do.
users.invited_existing: {{name}} already has a Kadai account — they sign in with their own password.
users.invited_otp: {{name}} added. They sign in with an OTP sent to their mobile.
users.disable_description: They are signed out at once and can't sign in to this business until you enable them again. Their bills and history stay.
users.empty_description: Invite your cashiers and managers so each bill shows who made it.
users.phone_hint: They sign in with this number
users.phone_locked: The mobile number can't be changed
users.role_not_allowed_owner_only: Only an owner can give this role
users.own_role_locked: You can't change your own role. Ask another owner.
users.single_store_note: Your business has one store, so they get access to it.
users.pin_hint: 4–6 digits to switch user at the counter. Can be set later.
users.first_login_temporary_hint: Kadai makes a password for you to hand over. Works without internet or SMS.
users.first_login_password_hint: Type a password now and tell them.
users.first_login_otp_hint: They get a one-time code on their mobile when they sign in.
users.pin_description: The PIN is used to switch users quickly at a registered counter.
users.pin_rules: Avoid easy PINs like 1234 or 0000. Setting a PIN also unlocks a locked PIN.
users.pin_locked_note: The PIN is locked after wrong tries until {{until}}. Saving a new PIN unlocks it.
users.password_description: They are signed out on every device and sign in again with the new password.
users.password_generate_hint: Shown once — hand it over or send it on WhatsApp.
users.password_choose_hint: Type a new password for them.

temp_password.title: Temporary password
temp_password.description: Give this password to {{name}} for their first sign-in.
temp_password.once: This password is shown only now. Note it down or send it before closing. They should change it after signing in.
temp_password.sign_in_with: Sign in with mobile {{phone}} and this password.
temp_password.whatsapp_text: Hello {{name}}, your Kadai sign-in: mobile {{phone}}, temporary password {{password}}. Please change it after you sign in. {{url}}

roles.description: A role decides what a member can see and do. Give each person the smallest role they need.
roles.new_description: Pick a name and tick what this role may do.
roles.duplicate: A role with this name already exists
roles.system_hint: Ready-made roles that suit most shops. Their permissions are fixed.
roles.custom_hint: Roles you made for your shop's way of working.
roles.custom_empty_description: Copy a built-in role and adjust it, e.g. a senior cashier who may give bigger discounts.
roles.system_description: A built-in Kadai role. Its permissions can't be changed — copy it to make your own.
roles.system_note: Built-in roles are updated with Kadai so new screens work for them right away.
roles.delete_description: Only roles that nobody has can be deleted.
roles.name: Role name
roles.code_hint: Optional; made from the name when empty
roles.not_grantable: You don't have this permission yourself

invoice.description: How your bills look and print. The preview shows a sample bill with your settings.
invoice.print_format_hint: Each counter can override this in Counters & devices.
invoice.format_a4_hint: Full-page GST invoice for business customers
invoice.copies_hint: A4 copies are marked Original, Duplicate, Triplicate.
invoice.bilingual_hint: Item names, labels and amount in words in both languages.
invoice.show_hsn_hint: Needed on tax invoices for businesses with turnover above ₹5 crore; useful for all.
invoice.show_mrp_savings_hint: Customers love seeing how much they saved against MRP.
invoice.upi_qr_hint: For the bill amount or the balance due — customers can scan and pay.
invoice.round_none_hint: Collect the exact amount with paise
invoice.price_includes_tax_hint: New products and quick items: the price you type already includes GST (typical MRP retail).
invoice.terms_hint: Printed at the bottom, e.g. exchange or warranty terms.
invoice.pos_link: Stock rules, discount limits, scale barcodes and quick keys are in POS & stock settings.
invoice.preview_note: Sample items; your logo, store GSTIN and UPI ID are used on real bills.

receipt.scan_pay: Scan & pay with any UPI app

pos.description: Rules for the billing counter and stock, weighing-scale barcodes and quick keys.
pos.negative_stock: Allow billing when stock shows zero
pos.negative_stock_hint: Bill first, fix stock later — handy when purchases are entered late. Pharmacies usually turn this off.
pos.low_stock_alerts_hint: Warn when items fall to their reorder level.
pos.fefo_hint: Batches expiring sooner are picked first at billing.
pos.expiry_warning_days_hint: Days before expiry that a batch is shown as expiring soon.
pos.batches_not_in_plan: Batch & expiry rules are available with the batches & expiry feature.
pos.max_discount_hint: Bigger discounts need a manager (discount override permission).
pos.price_edit_hint: Allow editing the selling price on the bill.
pos.customer_for_credit_hint: A credit (khata) bill must have a customer.
pos.sound_hint: A short sound when an item is added.
pos.require_shift_hint: Each counter starts with an opening cash count.
pos.section_scale_hint: Labels printed by a weighing scale carry the item code and the weight or price.
pos.scale_enabled_hint: Scanned labels add the right item and weight to the bill.
pos.scale_prefixes_hint: First digits of the scale's labels, separated by commas
pos.scale_test_hint: Scan or type a barcode from your scale to see how Kadai reads it
pos.scale_fail_check_digit: Check digit is wrong — scan again
pos.scale_fail_prefix: This prefix is not in your list — it will be read as a normal barcode
pos.scale_fail_zero: The value in this barcode is zero
pos.quick_keys_hint: Fast buttons on the billing screen for items sold all day (tea, milk, bags).
pos.quick_keys_add: Add a product to quick keys
pos.quick_keys_empty: No quick keys yet. Add your fastest-selling items.

pharmacy.description: Prescription rules and registers for medicines.
pharmacy.section_rx_hint: For these schedules the counter asks for the doctor and the prescription.
pharmacy.schedule_H_hint: Prescription medicines (most antibiotics, BP and sugar tablets).
pharmacy.schedule_H1_hint: Antibiotics and habit-forming drugs — recorded in the H1 register.
pharmacy.schedule_X_hint: Narcotic and psychotropic drugs — keep the prescription copy.
pharmacy.schedule_G_hint: To be taken under medical supervision (e.g. antihistamines).
pharmacy.h1_register_hint: Every H1 sale records the patient, doctor and quantity for the drug inspector (Reports › H1 register).
pharmacy.stock_link: FEFO, expiry warnings and blocking expired batches are in POS & stock settings.

loyalty.description: Reward regular customers with points, and set how credit (khata) works.
loyalty.enabled_hint: Customers earn points on every bill and use them as a discount later.
loyalty.min_redeem_hint: Points needed before they can be used
loyalty.expiry_after_one: Points expire {{count}} day after they are earned
loyalty.expiry_after_other: Points expire {{count}} days after they are earned
loyalty.example: Example: a {{bill}} bill earns {{points}} points worth {{value}}. Customers can use points once they have {{min}}.
loyalty.credit_days_hint: Due date of credit bills, unless the customer has their own terms.
loyalty.block_over_limit: Stop credit bills over the limit
loyalty.block_over_limit_hint: A bill that takes a customer over their credit limit needs a manager.

series.description: How bills and other documents are numbered. Each store — and each billing counter for POS bills — has its own series every financial year.
series.empty_description: Series appear for every store and counter of the year.
series.rules: Numbers never repeat or go back. GST documents (tax invoices, bills of supply, credit and debit notes, receipts, vouchers, transfers) can be at most 16 characters long, as GST rules require.
series.too_long: Too long — GST allows at most {{max}} characters. Shorten the prefix or the padding.
series.next_number_new_hint: To continue your old billing software's numbering, enter its next number.
series.next_number_hint_one: {{count}} document issued so far — the number can only go up.
series.next_number_hint_other: {{count}} documents issued so far — the number can only go up.
series.force_warning_one: {{count}} document already uses the old prefix. New documents will use the new prefix; old numbers stay as they are.
series.force_warning_other: {{count}} documents already use the old prefix. New documents will use the new prefix; old numbers stay as they are.
series.force_confirm: I understand — change the prefix (recorded in the audit log)

audit.description: Every important change in Kadai — who did it, when and what changed.
audit.empty_description: Sign-ins, price changes, cancellations and settings changes will show up here.
